definitions.explanation: Unfair treatment of people based on race, gender, age, or other characteristics.
Making a distinction between things (neutral meaning, less common).

examples.japanese: {差別|さべつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されません→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
⟦{人種|じんしゅ}→人種：03354_jinshu⟧{差別|さべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
{差別|さべつ}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{扱|あつか}って→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{差別|さべつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no distinction between the two.

examples.japanese: ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{差別|さべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧です。
examples.english: It's important to make distinctions in quality.
examples.notes: {差別|さべつ}をつける = to differentiate

examples.japanese: ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{差別|さべつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかないほど⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It's so well made that you can't tell the difference between the real thing and the fake.
examples.notes: {差別|さべつ}がつく = to be able to distinguish

notes:
{差別|さべつ} primarily refers to discrimination (unfair treatment).

TRANSITIVITY (as suru verb):
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差別|さべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (discriminate against X)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{人種|じんしゅ}→人種：03354_jinshu⟧{差別|さべつ} (racial discrimination)
- ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{差別|さべつ} (gender discrimination)
- ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧{差別|さべつ} (age discrimination)
- {差別|さべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦なくす→無くす：01110_nakusu⟧ (eliminate discrimination)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧: distinction (neutral, classification)
- {差別|さべつ}: discrimination (usually negative)
- ⟦いじめ→いじめ：09092_ijime⟧: bullying
